review:
A retro sevens game with one simple idea: land Scatters, win jackpots. The more Scatters you get, the bigger the jackpot, and five of them pay the Grand at 1,500x your bet.

There's no respin bonus and no collect symbols, just quick classic spins with a jackpot ladder on top. Chance Level gives three options that multiply your bet to make jackpot combinations more likely. Wazdan rates it medium-low volatility with a 96.14% RTP, which makes it one of the calmer jackpot games in their catalogue. A good pick if Diamond Crown felt too swingy and you want the same retro feel at a lower top prize.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Free demo available on the Wazdan website
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
